name: Kinetic Mono
tagline: Apple-recap kinetic type. Black, white, one accent, hard cuts.

motion.direction: Apple-recap kinetic typography. Every line is 1–3 words, mixed case, centred, held 1–2 s, blurring in and diving out; cut hard between ideas, never fade the video. One accent word per line at most (`ter`). Numbers become `counter`s with no label clutter. Photos are straight full-width `imageCard`s (`tilt: 0`, x 70, w 940). Every 1.5–2.5 s a new line; keep the free zone clean — one element at a time. No stamps, no patterns, no tilted cards, no film strips.
